_about: Findings of the simulator walk that are already judged, so Scripts/ui-report.py sets them aside instead of raising them on every run. One entry per judgement: 'check' (the check's id, or * for any), 'screen' (a name, with * as a wildcard), 'label' (a regular expression on the finding's label, optional), 'config' (optional, with *), 'why' (one line: the check is wrong about this because…, or Matthew chose this on <date> in #<issue>). The reasoning in full is in .claude/skills/ios-ui-review/learnings.md. An entry is removed when what it covers is gone.

known.why: A bank's own description of a line (VERIZON WIRELESS), shown as the bank wrote it. The check is right about labels and wrong about data. 2026-11-24, #346.

known.label: ^(Page|Card|Text|Accent|Money in|Money out), #
known.why: A system ColorPicker row: the row already has a 44-point minimum height (rows are 44 points apart in the pictures) but the picker reports its inner 28-point element, and a frame can't change what it reports. Judged by Claude 2026-11-26, #361; Matthew hasn't ruled on it, so remove this entry if the rows turn out hard to hit on a phone.
